question:
Thank you for the update!
I have a quick question: why didn't Petelgeuse use possession against Julius?
answer:
Thanks for the hard work note!
And to answer your question: Pete-kun's "possession'' is basically a litmus test to gauge whether the target is someone he can possess.
And Julius had already summoned his spirits upon confronting Pete-kun, meaning he was already in a contracted state with other spirits. Spirit Arts User lore hadn't been fully disclosed yet so you wouldn't know, but originally contracting with multiple spirits requires specific procedures.
Frankly, Petelgeuse is an irregular spirit, so against an uncontracted person he can forcibly establish a contract and take over, but against someone already contracted his compatibility is terrible.
Pete-kun's natural enemy is a Spirit Arts User, and in this battle, Julius was the only one who fit the bill.
Emilia-tan could win too, but Emilia-tan has her own circumstances, so a fight against Petelgeuse wouldn't even occur in the first place. Puck is seriously useless.
